 Nuts & Bolts: Debut of Hometown Remix
 The Lightning host the Red Wings for the second time this month to kickoff a six-game homestand 
 By 
 Benjamin Pierce 
 TampaBayLightning.com 
 November 13, 2026 
 Link copied 
 Everything you need to know ahead of the Lightning's matchup against the Detroit Red Wings on Saturday:
 When: Saturday, November 14 - 7 p.m. ET
 Where:  Benchmark International Arena - Tampa, FL
 TV coverage: The Spot - Tampa Bay 66 (check local listings); Pregame show begins at 6:30 p.m. ET
 Radio coverage: 102.5 MHz-FM , Lightning Radio 24/7 
 Stream:   TampaBayLightning.com/StreamNow 
 Lines from Thursday's game (subject to change) 
 Forwards 
Brandon Hagel - Jake Guentzel - Nikita Kucherov
Ilya Mikheyev - Zemgus Girgensons - Pontus Holmberg 
Conor Geekie - Sam O'Reilly - Gage Goncalves
Jeff Viel - - Scott Sabourin
 Defensemen 
Charle-Edouard D'Astous - John Carlson
Victor Hedman - JJ Moser
Ryan McDonagh - Max Crozier
Emil Lilleberg
 Goaltenders 
Dennis Hildeby
Andrei Vasilevskiy
 Thursday's Matchup 
 The Lightning host the Detroit Red Wings for the second time this month with Saturday’s 7 p.m. game at Benchmark International Arena...Tampa Bay won the first matchup between the teams 4-2 on Nov. 3 in Tampa, led by 2-0—2 from Brayden Point, 0-2—2 from Nikita Kucherov and a 19-save win for Andrei Vasilevskiy...The Lightning are 44-37-7 all-time against Detroit, including 27-15-3 on home ice...Kucherov has scored 22-38—60 in 44 career games against the Red Wings to lead the franchise, and Victor Hedman has 5-37—42 to tie Steven Stamkos for second...Vasilevskiy is 20-5-2 with a .928 save percentage over his career against the Red Wings, while Dennis Hildeby is 0-0-1 with a .917 save percentage in one NHL start against Detroit as a member of the Toronto Maple Leafs...The Lightning went 3-0-1 against the Red Wings last season and were led in scoring by Kucherov (1-5—6) and Jake Guentzel (1-5—6).
 Tampa Bay Sports Item of the Game 
 Peter Millar Hometown Remix Collection 
The Tampa Bay Lightning play in the Hometown Remix jerseys for the first time tonight, and we've got a new collection drop to go with it!  Check out the Peter Millar Hometown Remix collection, available in store at Benchmark International Arena, and online at TampaBaySports.com , while supplies last. 
 The Road Ahead 
Tuesday, November 17 vs. Washington Capitals
Thursday, November 19 vs. Edmonton Oilers
Sunday, November 22 vs. Buffalo Sabres
